title: Demand Service Rate Programs: The Run of Months an Arrears Fee Covers
content:
*From what day do the months run?*

Where the most recent payment on the account reached the office later than the day the most recent
invoice fell due and the payments in the window do not clear the invoiced total, the months run from the
day of that payment, counting each month or part month up to the day the fee is raised. Where no payment
has reached the office since the most recent invoice fell due and that invoice has stood past its due
day longer than the tier's payment term, the months run from the day it fell due, counting each month or
part month up to the day the fee is raised. In any other case no run of months is counted from either
day.

*What is a part month worth?*

A part month counts as a month: each month or part month between the day the run starts and the day the
fee is raised is counted.

*Which payment term applies?* The one published for the program the account holds under the Demand Service Rate Programs:

| Program | Payment term (calendar days) |
|---|---|
| Time & Material Account | 30 |
| Priority Response Program | 30 |
| Block Hour Service Program | 30 |
| Emergency Response Program | 30 |
| Critical Facility Response Program | 45 |
| Dedicated Technician Program | 45 |

*The conditions in combination.*

| The most recent payment | The payments in the window | The most recent invoice to fall due | The run of months |
|---|---|---|---|
| reached the office later than the day that invoice fell due | do not clear the invoiced total | any | from the day of that payment |
| reached the office later than the day that invoice fell due | clear the invoiced total | any | no run is counted from either day |
| reached the office no later than that day, or none has reached it since | any | stands past its due day longer than the tier's payment term | from the day it fell due |
| reached the office no later than that day, or none has reached it since | any | stands past its due day no longer than the tier's payment term | no run is counted from either day |

*An illustration.* On the Critical Facility Response Program, whose payment term is 45 calendar days, an
invoice that fell due 100 days ago with no payment received since gives a run from that due day; where
the fee is raised 100 days later, that run covers 4 months, three whole months and a part month counting
as the fourth.
